title: NOT AS BRIGHT AS I EXPECTED
text: NOT AS BRIGHT AS I EXPECTED. This was to replace my microwave light that burned out.  I found a video online on how to do the replacement and it was very easy.  Apparently a lot of Panasonic microwaves use this same bulb.  The bulb is not nearly as bright as the one I replaced, but it is LED, so should last longer.  Of course the light is not essential to the operation of the microwave, but does help when putting food in and tells you visually when it is running.  I am sure that I saved an expensive appliance service call by replacing the bulb myself.  These particular bulbs come two to a package and are still less expensive than some comparable ones that are only sold singly.
